positions.title: Web Developer, UX/UI Designer, Information Architect
Sr. Web UI Developer & Analyst
positions.description:
Web UI Development for an internal application built with Google Apps Script. 
Front-End Development for a hybrid application built with AngularJS and PhoneGap.

positions.title: Sr. Web UI/UX, Front-End Developer
positions.description:
I participated in the development of a Single Page Application (SPA) built with HTML5, AngularJS, Bootstrap and CSS3 for the various types of insurance products that BBVA Bancomer has to offer.

The main activities I developed were: wireframe creation; Usability testing and UI/UX analysis; Front-End Development; Cross browsing and QA tests; use of JavaScript; implementation of jQuery plug-ins and effects; creation of AngularJS views, services, controllers, filters and components.

positions.title: Sr. Web UI/UX, Front-End Developer
positions.description:
I participated in the redesign and migration projects of AcciTrade, Transfer and Banamex websites to HTML5, as well as the development of Mobile Web Applications for iPad. 

The principal activities I developed were: migration from XHTML to HTML5; UI/UX Front-End Development; appliance of a Global Framework created and used by Citibank that dictates the color, typography and layout rules for their websites; development of SmartBanking from Banamex, an HTML5 Web Application for iPad; creating AJAX applications with XML and JSON; and make use of jQuery plug-ins and effects.

positions.title: Web UI/UX, Front-End Developer
positions.description:
The main project consisted in migrating and redesigning Liverpool’s (department store) website, which also included a mobile version, iOS and Android application development as well. 

My main activities consisted in: migrating the old XHTML to the new semantic HTML5, make use of some of the new available APIs and apply CSS3 to create Modern Web Applications; wireframe creation with online tools; Usability testing and UI/UX analysis; use of JavaScript; implementation of jQuery plug-ins and effects; Cross browsing and QA tests; Semantic Web/tags, SEO friendly; Mobile Web strategies and development.

positions.title: Blog Administrator
positions.description: For this project my main activities were creating blog entries, programming their publishing date and editing its content with WordPress.
